name: Scratch
description: Scratch is the worlds largest coding community for children and the best way to start programming. It teaches computational thinking through a visual block-based interface used by millions worldwide.

items.title: Scratch Wiki
items.description: The collaboratively-written official encyclopedia with deep concept explanations and block documentation.

items.title: Harvard ScratchEd Guides
items.description: Free PDF lesson plans, activity guides, and creative coding prompts from Harvard.

items.title: Scratch Ideas Page
items.description: Official project ideas, interactive tutorials, and starter templates.

items.title: Scratch Foundation Learning Library
items.description: Curated activities, printable coding cards, and lesson plans.

items.title: CS50 Introduction to Scratch (Harvard)
items.description: World-class free course teaching computational thinking through Scratch by Professor David Malan.

items.title: Scratch Official Video Tutorials
items.description: Official short video walkthroughs covering sprites, sound, events, and paint editor.

items.title: Scratch Online Editor
items.description: The primary browser-based coding environment with drag-and-drop blocks and instant preview.

items.title: All Blocks of Scratch PDF
items.description: Color-coded visual guide mapping all 100+ blocks across 9 categories.

items.title: Scratch Foundation News
items.description: Official announcements, platform updates, and educational research.

items.description: Official massive discussion board for help, collaboration, and project feedback.
